reason: The label is actually clean: water, cold-brewed mate, citrus concentrate, no sweeteners, which is rare for anything in a can. I'd grab one or two at a café before a training session to try it, but at home I'd still make my own matcha.
objection: 55 CZK for what is basically cold mate with lemon, when I can brew yerba or matcha myself for a fraction of that. Also I'd want to see the sugar content from the concentrate before calling it clean.
would_change_my_mind: A full nutrition panel showing near-zero sugar plus a multipack price around 40 CZK a can would make it a weekly pre-workout habit instead of an occasional try.
